query:
SELECT r.resolutionId,cr.tdocNumber,r.content
FROM Resolution r JOIN rel_REFERENCES rr ON rr.src_id=r.node_id
JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=rr.dst_id JOIN rel_MODIFIES mo ON mo.src_id=cr.node_id
JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=mo.dst_id WHERE sp.specNumber='38.331'
ORDER BY r.resolutionId DESC
